subject: Leadership readout: outcomes, risk gates, pilot funding ask
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Green <emma.green@novamed.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Leadership readout: outcomes, risk gates, pilot funding ask

Emma / Carlos — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick leadership-focused readout so your execs have a crisp place to land and we can move the pilot forward this week. I captured outcomes, open risks, procurement path, and asks for your leadership below.

Key pain points (as described):
- Production latency spikes on user-facing summarization pipelines (95th pctl ~= 320ms at 2k tokens) causing UX drop-off.
- Cost volatility and lack of predictable unit economics for peak periods.
- Data residency and audit log needs for regulated workflows in EU/US regions.

Business goals (mutually agreed):
1) Reduce 95th pctl end-to-end generation latency to <= 180ms for critical flows.
2) Establish a stable per-token cost band for monthly forecasting.
3) Pilot in US region with audit logging and KMS integration; assess path to VPC/private deployment if controls are required.

Success metrics for pilot (30-day):
- Latency: 95th pctl <= 180ms on 1–2k token requests (measured on your preprod load).
- Cost: unit cost reduction >= 20% vs current trough using Redwood batching/caching.
- Security: SOC2 evidence review + KMS integration validated by Novamed security contact.

Open risks / gating items for leadership: 
- Security review window: your InfoSec needs the SOC2 excerpt and a short runbook for key rotation (attached). If they require an HSM demo, schedule may shift ~2 weeks.
- Procurement terms: Novamed standard PO + SOW ok, but you indicated finance needs approval for pilot spend outside the standard cycle; will need a leadership signoff for a $60k pilot commitment.
- SLA exceptions: your ops team asked about a 99.9% token throughput SLA for the pilot—this is higher than Redwood's default hosted tier; we can provide a targeted SLA for Dedicated or a limited-time commitment with an operational playbook, but that requires legal review.

Immediate asks for your execs (one-liners):
- Approve the $60k pilot budget and confirm the PO owner by EOD Thursday. (Owner: Carlos?)
- Fast-track InfoSec review of the attached SOC2 excerpt; share a point-of-contact for KMS/architecture.
- Confirm availability for a 20-minute CIO touchpoint Tuesday 10am ET to align on escalation triggers and success criteria.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 5/19 (today): Leadership readout; internal prepping of short CFO one-pager (we will share).
- Wed 5/20: Procurement/PO draft + SOW v1 (attached) — aim to have procure@novamed review.
- Thu 5/21: InfoSec signoff or list of remaining blockers.
- Mon 5/25: Kick pilot (conditional on PO + security).

Attachments included: Draft_SOW_Novamed_v1.docx, SOC2-excerpt.pdf, MAP-Novamed-20260519.xlsx

Next steps (owners):
- Carlos: confirm PO owner and internal approval window.
- Emma: share InfoSec contact and confirm CIO availability.
- Marissa (Redwood AE): finalize CFO one-pager and cost breakdown by EOD.
- Rachel (Redwood Product): prepare short ops playbook + SLA options.

I will follow up after I hear back from Carlos/Emma and update the MAP in Drive (link below). Thanks — happy to make any edits to this note for format your execs prefer.

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Emma Green <emma.green@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Leadership readout: outcomes, risk gates, pilot funding ask

Thanks Olga — helpful summary. Quick responses inline and a couple of asks from my side.

On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 9:14 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Emma / Carlos — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick leadership-focused readout ...

- PO owner: Carlos is the right contact and I will push for an expedited approval. I anticipate we can clear a pilot PO but need to confirm whether the $60k can be signed off by procurement or requires CFO approval. I will know by Thu EOD.
- InfoSec: I am looping in our Head of InfoSec (Jenna Park) separately; she requested the SOC2 excerpt and a short KMS integration diagram (can you provide?).
- CIO touchpoint: tentative for Tue 5/26 10am ET (not 10am next Tuesday). I will confirm the exact slot by tomorrow.

Two asks from me:
1) Can Redwood provide a 1-page CFO-friendly cost/benefit that compares current spend to expected pilot spend and projected monthly ops cost if we move to Dedicated? Marissa — can you lead that?
2) If SLA exceptions require a legal addendum, can we surface the redlines we should expect up front so our GC can triage?

Appreciate the rapid cadence — Emma
Emma Green | VP Product, Novamed
emma.green@novamed.com | +1 617-555-0987

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Green <emma.green@novamed.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:25:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Leadership readout: outcomes, risk gates, pilot funding ask

Thanks — jumping in on the CFO one-pager and procurement redlines. Short internal note for our leadership before I send to Novamed: 

Internal escalation items: 
- If Novamed requires HSM/HSM-backed KMS for pilot, cost + timeline increases materially; we should present a fallback (KMS in-hosting + audit logs) and a path to HSM as a paid upgrade.
- SLA ask: propose we offer a targeted 30-day operational commitment (ops playbook + proactive on-call) instead of a formal 99.9% availability SLA for hosted pilot. If they insist, route to Dedicated quoting.

I'm putting together:
- CFO one-pager: cost today vs pilot vs Dedicated projection (will include assumptions and sensitivity).
- Procurement redline primer: 3 likely redline areas (SLA, data residency, termination liability) with suggested language.

Marissa --> I will share both docs as drafts by 5pm ET so Olga can attach to the HubSpot record and send to Emma/Carlos. If Novamed asks for accelerated PO approval, recommend we flag a leadership escalation to product + finance to speed governance.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Green <emma.green@novamed.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:06:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Leadership readout: outcomes, risk gates, pilot funding ask

Appreciate the quick replies — good alignment so far. A few short confirmations and final asks before I close the loop with our leadership team: 

- Carlos: if you can confirm the PO owner and whether CFO signoff is required by Thu EOD, we will lock the pilot timeline.
- Emma: I will drop the KMS integration diagram and a short runbook for key rotation into Drive now (link below). Jenna — great to meet you by email; if you prefer a 30-min technical review instead of documents-only, we can set that up Wednesday.
- Marissa: thanks — please mark the CFO one-pager "Novamed - Pilot CFO one-pager v1" in Drive and I will attach to HubSpot (HS-8741) and forward to Novamed leadership.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-ExampleDriveLink
HubSpot: HS-8741

I will also prepare a 6-slide CIO briefing (1-slide pain, 1-slide pilot plan, 1-slide measurable outcomes, 1-slide SLA/options, 1-slide cost, 1-slide escalations) and share before EOD for your CIO read. If the CIO prefers, I can present live Tue 5/26 10am ET.

Closing ask: please confirm the PO owner and InfoSec contact by Thu EOD so we can keep the momentum window open — we typically see decision pressure ease if procurement/finance take longer than a week.

Thanks — I will follow up with the updated MAP and the attachments mentioned.

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
